name: Kuro Gyaru Bitch-ka Keikaku! ~Hikikomori Imouto o Inran Kousei~
original_name: 黒ギャルビッチ化計画っ！ ～引き篭もり妹を淫乱更生～
source:
"Eh...? Y-You're kidding..? You mean we're going to be separated, Onii-chan? I'm too scared to even leave my room without you..."

My little sister Mei loves staying at home. It sounds nice, but to put it bluntly, she's just a shut-in. Though there was a reason for it, Mei now rejects even our parents and refuses to see anyone but me. She's completely dependent on me.

It's about time she moved on from me... the truth is, I... want to be free from Mei.

But she has no such intention, and my parents are apparently desperate not to lose me as her caretaker.

Then one day, I came across a story: "A former plain girl became a black gyaru under her boyfriend's influence and reinvented herself."

"I see, that method could work...!"

I couldn't sit still any longer and burst out of my room. My destination, of course, was Mei's room.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1062369]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
“呃……？你、你开玩笑吧……？你的意思是我们要分开了，哥哥？没有你，我什至不敢离开我的房间……”

我的妹妹梅喜欢呆在家里。听起来不错，但说白了，她就是一个闭关自守的人。虽然这是有原因的，但梅现在甚至拒绝了我们的父母，除了我之外拒绝见任何人。她完全依赖我。

她是时候离开我了……事实是，我……想摆脱梅的束缚。

但她没有这样的意图，而我的父母显然非常不希望失去我作为她的看护人。

然后有一天，我看到一个故事：“一个原本平凡的女孩在男友的影响下变成了黑辣妹，并重塑了自己。”

“原来如此，这个方法可行啊……！”

我再也坐不住了，冲出了我的房间。我的目的地当然是梅的房间。

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1062369]Getchu[/url]]
